overview.description: The MAX Airlines 3X Leveraged ETNs (JETU) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Prime Airlines index. The fund tracks 3x the daily price movements of an index consisting of US-listed companies in the air transportation industry, these include airlines, air freight and logistics, and aircraft and parts manufacturing. The index is selected and weighted by market cap JETU was launched on Jun 23, 2023 and is issued by Max.
